# Ridham Pokiya — Personal Portfolio

> DevOps & Cloud Engineer | SaaS Founder | AWS Specialist | India

This is the official portfolio of Ridham Pokiya, an Indian DevOps and Cloud Engineer.

## About

Ridham Pokiya is a DevOps & Cloud Engineer from Gujarat, India, specialising in:
- AWS serverless architectures (Lambda, S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, API Gateway)
- Automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CodePipeline)
- Container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
- SaaS product development and ERP systems
- Data analysis and Python automation

He is the founder of two SaaS products:
1. **Heeratrack** (https://www.heeratrack.com) — Diamond Business Management ERP SaaS for diamond merchants
2. **Validexio** (https://validexio.com) — Startup Idea Validation Platform with real-time competitor data

He is an AWS Student Builder Core Member at PPSU (Parul University) and holds 20+ technical certifications.
